limitations: Monthly demand for long-tail title suggestions not independently measured.
Ubersuggest keyword data varied between endpoints; use domain_keywords/match_keywords when present and revalidate before claiming traffic.
No guarantee of Google page-one position within any number of months.
This is research input, NOT QA-PASS, PLANNED, a WordPress post or proof of indexation.

operational_rules: Prioritize owner-approved existing URL improvements outside publishing pipeline.
Research new supporting ideas one question/intent per URL; check whole WordPress + canonical Topic Registry + peer batches before importing.
External AI gathers genuine source evidence and full-content comparisons, submits through research_v2 and existing Research QA.
Only accepted PLANNED topics are writable by W1–W9; QA >=85 and publishing guards unchanged.
Do not add doorway area pages, duplicate price pages or new exact-match homepage targets.
Do not change existing titles, slugs, canonical, sitemap, menu, production flags or WordPress posts as part of this import.
Check actual service coverage and product availability; never claim unsupported pickup/delivery/policies.
